{{Quote|Captain! We've been boarded by a Jedi!''"<br />"''This is Dooku's fault! To the escape pods!|Pundar and the pirate prepare to abandon ship over Fondor|<ref name="Strange Allies" />}}
A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] '''pirate''' was part of [[Dool Pundar]]'s crew, serving on the [[Lucrehulk-class|''Lucrehulk''-class]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Profit (Lucrehulk-class battleship)|''Profit'']]<ref name="Strange Allies" /> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="Annual">''[[Star Wars Annual 2011]]'' places the [[Battle of the Kaliida Nebula/Legends|Battle of the Kaliida Nebula]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The battle takes place just prior to the ''Secret Missions'' series.</ref> The Neimoidian pirate had [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and red [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] common to the [[Species/Legends|species]], though a scar ran across the right eye. The pirate was on the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] when the ship [[Skirmish at the Fondor Shipyards|ambushed]] [[Noggox]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] at the [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]], and directed the vessel's firepower. When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Nuru Kungurama]] crashed the freighter onboard, the pirate informed Pundar of the infiltration. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] then ordered the crew to abandon ship.<ref name="Strange Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Neimoidian pirate appears in [[2011]]'s ''[[The Clone Wars: Strange Allies]]'', a comic tie-in to the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Secret Missions]]'' series.
